entities.summary: Rebecca Lee Lok-sze is a Hong Kong explorer. She is the first Hongkonger and the first woman to have visited the North Pole, the South Pole, and Mount Everest. Lee has also visited the Yarlung Tsangpo Canyon and the Taklamakan desert.
